## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: A non-bug ticket that carries a detected_by:<channel> tag does not appear in .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --has-tag=detected_by:tests
- dd-2: A bug ticket filed at or after M1 ship date that carries detected_by:tests does appear in the result
- dd-3: Test exercises both cases (non-bug with tag is excluded; bug with tag is included)

Modify plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-list.sh to add a --has-tag=<tag> filter argument. When the tag value is in the detected_by:* namespace (i.e., matches ^detected_by:), automatically intersect with --type=bug so the query returns ONLY bug-type tickets with that tag.

Behavior:
- --has-tag=detected_by:tests → returns only tickets where ticket_type=bug AND 'detected_by:tests' is in the tags array
- --has-tag=<any-other-tag> → returns all ticket types with that tag (no type intersection)

Also add the --has-tag argument to ticket-list.sh's usage/help output so calibration-report.sh and /dso:test-quality-report can use it.

Create tests/scripts/test-ticket-list-has-tag.sh covering:
1. A bug ticket with detected_by:tests tag → appears in --has-tag=detected_by:tests results
2. A non-bug ticket (story) with detected_by:tests tag → does NOT appear in --has-tag=detected_by:tests results
3. A non-bug ticket with detected_by:tests tag → DOES appear in --has-tag=detected_by:tests results when combined with --has-tag=<non-detected_by-tag> (no type intersection on other tags)
4. An empty result when no matching tickets exist → exits 0 with empty array

Use ticket stubs (mktemp fixture dir, PATH-prepended stub) so test runs deterministically.

## Testing Mode
RED — write the test first; it fails because --has-tag is not yet implemented. Then add the flag.

## Acceptance Criteria
- ticket-list.sh usage includes --has-tag flag — Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-list.sh --help 2>&1 | grep -q 'has-tag'
- --has-tag=detected_by:tests returns only bug-type tickets with that tag — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ticket-list-has-tag.sh
- Test file is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-ticket-list-has-tag.sh
- ShellCheck passes — Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-list.sh
- Existing tests still pass — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-list.sh — Edit
- tests/scripts/test-ticket-list-has-tag.sh — Create
data.title: Add --has-tag flag to ticket-list.sh with detected_by namespace auto-type-intersection
